design: factorial hand-pollination x natural herbivory manipulation
quantitative_anchor: hand pollination increased female fitness 31%; ~25% plants herbivore damaged; pollinators selected later flowering while herbivores selected earlier flowering; both selected longer spurs; agent strengths described as similar and additive
claim_boundary: No significant trait x pollination x herbivory interaction; additive effects can still generate changing net selection as relative interaction intensity changes

design: grazer exclusion x pollen supplementation replicated across four sites
selection_metric: experimental relative fitness of long-vs-short scape morphs
quantitative_anchor: pollinator-mediated selection favoured long scapes; grazer-mediated selection favoured short scapes; differences in relative interaction strength explained among-population selection and morph-frequency evolution
claim_boundary: Selection is on a genetically based display dimorphism rather than continuous beta gradients

design: simulated meristem herbivory x pollen supplementation
quantitative_anchor: clipping changed selection for earlier flowering and weakened selection on inflorescence number; no difference in pollen limitation and no evidence clipping altered pollinator-mediated selection
claim_boundary: Simulated damage tests tolerance pathway rather than consumer preference

design: cyanogenic defence x herbivore suppression x hand pollination
quantitative_anchor: herbivores imposed ~2.7x stronger selection than pollinators across traits; no pollen limitation; defence modified herbivore-mediated selection and pollinator effects on flowering time
claim_boundary: Defence phenotype is an endogenous gate as well as a focal trait state

design: full factorial open-vs-hand pollination x herbivore addition/removal
context_axis: presence/ecological effect of the other agent
quantitative_anchor: pollinators implicated on 4/9 traits and herbivores on 2/9; pollinators generally stronger; opposing selection on inflorescence density; every detected regime was diffuse/context-dependent
claim_boundary: Only 27 genotypes had complete metabolomic trait data although 81 genotypes had full replication

design: ungulate exclusion with pollinator preference and fecundity pathway
quantitative_anchor: without ungulates significant selection occurred on multiple floral/display traits; with ungulates floral selection disappeared and morphological selection weakened
claim_boundary: Pollination was not experimentally supplemented/excluded; sensitivity evidence only

design: hand-pollination experiment plus herbivore path analysis
selection_metric: standardized selection gradients plus path analysis
quantitative_anchor: pollinators caused stronger selection than three herbivore groups; herbivore effects were weak but significant on a subset of traits
claim_boundary: Herbivores were not experimentally manipulated so agent comparison has method asymmetry

design: cage communities with bumblebees cabbage butterflies or both
quantitative_anchor: phenylacetaldehyde selection in mixed treatment was 0.20±0.08 below additive expectation (P=0.009); 1-butene-4-isothiocyanate was 0.19±0.08 above additive expectation (P=0.018)
claim_boundary: Pieris brassicae is simultaneously pollinator and herbivore so it cannot cleanly estimate separate agent dominance

design: 11-year grazer exclusion with pollinator and seed-predator mediated selection
quantitative_anchor: grazer exclusion strengthened pollinator selection for tall inflorescences and seed-predator selection for short inflorescences; indirect effects became similar to direct grazer effects late in experiment
claim_boundary: Same long-term Primula farinosa research programme as MAS02; clustered sensitivity only
